bio.short: I’m Sandesh, a full-stack developer at Branofy in Bengaluru. I build websites, web apps and dashboards, then make sure search engines, answer engines and AI systems can find, understand and cite them.

story.text: I started by learning how things work.

Two frontend internships. A machine-learning model that classified breast-cancer cases from diagnostic data. A finalist spot at an internal Smart India Hackathon. An AI interview coach built with friends. Then Branofy, where I joined as an intern and shipped real client work: travel platforms, real-estate listings, a resort, a co-living booking flow, an internal CRM.
Then I realized building the website was only part of the problem.
That led me deeper into SEO, then AEO, then GEO: understanding not only how digital products are built, but how they become discoverable, understandable and citable.

Today I work at Branofy as a full-stack developer who also owns the SEO, AEO and GEO layer of what we ship. I moved into that role from the internship where I started, and most weeks I still do both halves: build the thing, then make sure it can be found.
